proposal.expected_reason: CP-SAT with max_seconds=1 on G_dual_bottleneck will return a verified complete-batch Makespan strictly below the 199.0 s rule baseline, with lower chamber blocking and lower average wafer waiting, because it can jointly optimize transfer ordering and blocking rather than serializing transfers as the bottleneck rule does.
proposal.selection_reason: G_dual_bottleneck has only a rule baseline (199.0 s, ~3.55x the 56.0 s nominal lower bound) with 78.0 s chamber blocking and monotonically increasing wafer waiting, indicating robot serialization dominates under the rule policy. CP-SAT is the cheapest method that can jointly optimize transfer ordering and blocking. The untried CP budget for this scenario is 1 s (estimated ~4 s wall), well within the remaining wall budget (~537 s) and remaining CP search budget (56 s). This tests whether the rule baseline is far from optimal.
